note: Equipment review: Jorge Wood’s report describes Chilean rifle fire from concealed shore positions against Blanca. The long-arm infantry and wooden screw-and-sail warship are equipment analogies; the latter represents Blanca rather than the accompanying ironclad Numancia. Exact uniforms, rig and gun arrangement remain unspecified.
